description: Project foundation and Firebase setup: Add all required dependencies to pubspec.yaml with pinned versions (firebase_core, firebase_auth, cloud_firestore, flutter_riverpod, riverpod_annotation, shared_preferences, cached_network_image, intl), create complete lib/ folder structure (models/, services/, providers/, pages/, widgets/, utils/), create Firebase service wrapper classes, and add placeholder notes for Firebase configuration files that the user must obtain from Firebase Console.
steps: Update d:\higo\pubspec.yaml to add dependencies: firebase_core: 3.8.0, firebase_auth: 5.3.3, cloud_firestore: 5.5.0, flutter_riverpod: 2.6.1, riverpod_annotation: 2.6.1, shared_preferences: 2.3.4, cached_network_image: 3.4.1, intl: 0.19.0. Also add dev_dependencies: riverpod_generator: 2.6.5, build_runner: 2.4.15, riverpod_lint: 2.6.3.
Create d:\higo\lib\models\user_model.dart with User class (id, email, displayName, photoUrl, createdAt) using JSON serialization
Create d:\higo\lib\models\message_model.dart with Message class (id, chatRoomId, senderId, senderName, text, timestamp, read) using JSON serialization
Create d:\higo\lib\models\chat_room_model.dart with ChatRoom class (id, participants, lastMessage, lastMessageTime, unreadCount) using JSON serialization
Create d:\higo\lib\services\firebase_service.dart to initialize Firebase with error handling
Create d:\higo\lib\services\auth_service.dart with methods: signUp, signIn, signOut, getCurrentUser using firebase_auth
Create d:\higo\lib\services\firestore_service.dart with methods for CRUD operations on users, chat_rooms, and messages collections
Create d:\higo\lib\services\cache_service.dart using shared_preferences to cache current user data
Create d:\higo\lib\utils\constants.dart for Firebase collection names, error messages in Arabic, and app constants
Create d:\higo\lib\utils\validators.dart for email and password validation with Arabic error messages
Create d:\higo\android\app\google-services.json.example as a placeholder file with instructions in comment for the user to obtain actual file from Firebase Console
Create d:\higo\ios\Runner\GoogleService-Info.plist.example as a placeholder file with instructions
Create d:\higo\FIREBASE_SETUP.md with detailed Arabic instructions for obtaining Firebase configuration files from Firebase Console
acceptance_criteria: pubspec.yaml contains all required dependencies with exact pinned versions
All model classes have proper fromJson and toJson methods
All service classes are created with complete method signatures and basic implementations
Firebase configuration placeholder files and setup instructions exist
flutter analyze shows no errors for the created files
findings: Successfully implemented all steps. Fixed riverpod_lint version from 2.6.3 to 2.6.5 to resolve dependency conflict with riverpod_generator 2.6.5. All files created with proper structure, Arabic error messages, and JSON serialization. flutter pub get and flutter analyze both executed successfully with no errors.
